paragraphs: Otzar Yisrael cites him from Yalkut, Isaiah, remez 391, but Hyman says he has not found him in his Yalkut.[^1]

notes.text: The whole actual Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 391 paragraph does name Rabbi Tanchum bar Nachmani. This supports the local full title while Hyman’s statement that he did not find the name in his Yalkut remains his historical observation. It is not a new absence claim, a claim about his edition, or proof of a correction history; Otzar Yisrael was not freshly collated.
